text.tspan: Run-off assay using modified construct, HA
tag used in front of FSS and 0 frame post FSS
The mRNA has a frame shifting site (FSS) which
is either on or off, sending ribosomes to the 0 or +1
frame. Ribosomes translate a different color epitope
depending on the frame they are in downstream
Bound fluorophores are photobleached on an
mRNA for a short time period and then allowed
Trailing ribosomes accelerate depending on how
close they are to leading ribosomes.
The mRNA has two open reading frames, one controlled
by canonical CAP mediated initiation and the other by
an Internal Ribosomal Entry Site (IRES). Each ORF
has its own color epitope. Initiation statuses are
dictated by a four state bursting model.
